I am happy every day. We often go to the library together. My friend Nina is very kind. What's more, let's have lunch together.
Nina likes bread too. The moon-lit yard is my favorite place. Tom goes to the library on Sunday. What's more, we always spend the summer holiday at the beach.
We talk about art a lot. Nina often helps me with art. Tom wears a hat today.
